# PART 1 – The claim and credibility {#part-1-the-claim-and-credibility .darkslide background-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"}

::: {.partlabel}
Part 1
:::

::: notes
Part one starts further back than you might expect, with what science is for, why many think it is in trouble, and the red-card study, in which twenty-nine teams analysed one dataset and disagreed. Then come the vocabulary that separates three kinds of repetition and the three large studies of SCORE, published together, which measured how often findings in the social sciences survive each kind, and one of which supplies our case study. The part ends on that case study, the published experiment that we work on all day, and before the break you run the setup check, so that R is ready on your machine.
:::
